text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their second Summer Training Camp. King 
Halo drags along Seiun Sky, who seems 
completely unmotivated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can only hope this is really just her 
usual "pretending" to slack off. With 
lingering unease in the air, the summer 
training camp began.
